program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_b": (22.0, 14.0, 26.0),    # bottom mirror devices gm/Id (weak inversion -> tiny Vdsat)
    "L_b":    (1.0, 0.5, 3.0),       # bottom L (matching + ro)
    "gmid_c": (23.0, 14.0, 26.0),    # cascode devices gm/Id
    "L_c":    (0.5, 0.25, 2.0),      # cascode L
    "vds_b":  (0.085, 0.06, 0.14),   # target Vds of bottom devices
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = spec.get("iin", 20e-6)
    vout = spec.get("vout_nom", 0.9)
    vds_b = p["vds_b"]

    # bottom (mirror) devices: input Ma, output Mb -- identical, same Vds
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L_b"], I, vds=vds_b)
    # cascode devices: identical Md (input) and Mc (output); source at vds_b (body effect)
    mc = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], I, vds=max(vout - vds_b, 0.1), vsb=vds_b)
    md = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], I, vds=max(mb.vgs - vds_b, 0.1), vsb=vds_b)

    # Bias resistor: V_A (cascode gates) = vds_b + Vgs_c ; V_B (mirror gates) = Vgs_b
    R = (vds_b + md.vgs - mb.vgs) / I
    R = max(R, 100.0)

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    # input branch: iin -> R -> nb (drain of Md) ; Md source -> xa (drain of Ma)
    n.R("RB", "iin", "nb", R)
    n.dev("MD", "nb", "iin", "xa", "vss", mc)     # input cascode, gate at top of R
    n.dev("MA", "xa", "nb", "vss", "vss", mb)     # input mirror device, gate at bottom of R
    # output branch
    n.dev("MC", "iout", "iin", "xb", "vss", mc)   # output cascode
    n.dev("MB", "xb", "nb", "vss", "vss", mb)     # output mirror device

    # predictions
    gm_c = mc.gm + mc.gmbs
    ro_c = 1.0 / mc.gds
    ro_b = 1.0 / mb.gds
    rout = ro_c + ro_b + gm_c * ro_c * ro_b
    # compliance: bottom needs ~3UT for 95%; cascode needs ~its vdsat on top of vds_b
    v_comp = vds_b + 0.6 * mc.vdsat
    # error: Ma/Mb same Vds by construction; residual from finite rout of cascode mismatch
    err = 100.0 * abs(vout - (vds_b + md.vgs - mc.vgs + mb.vgs - vds_b)) / (rout * I) * 0.05
    return n, {"iout_err_pct": err, "rout": rout, "v_compliance": v_comp,
               "power": 2 * I * 1.8}
